blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Justice (DOJ) is in the final stages of reviewing the extradition request of the United States for Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Apollo Quiboloy. Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida spoke about this in a press conference on Thursday. Vida said government prosecutors are conducting a “legal scrubbing” and completing the last phases of polishing the document before formally lodging the petition in court. “We’re in the final stages already of the vetting. We are already in the legal scrubbing,” the secretary told reporters. “DOJ will be filing soon… within the year.” He said the Philippines remains steadfast […]...
